description: Download one file attached to your submission and save it to local disk. Returns the saved path. Get the URL from list_submission_attachments.

filename.description: File name to save as. Defaults to the attachment's own name.

url.description: Download URL of the attachment: the attachments[].url field from list_submission_attachments or get_my_submission. It must be an address on your Canvas.

name: download_submission_attachment
title: Download Submission Attachment
